verdict.rationale: A probe got HTTP 200 for llms.txt on GitBook's own site, and GitBook's published docs serve a full-content variant at /docs/llms-full.txt. GitBook also has an 'LLM-ready docs' page and lists 'LLM optimizations' as a pricing feature, which together suggest this is a platform capability rather than a one-off. Missing for 10: the docs evidence is only titles, with no quoted text confirming that every customer site generates these files automatically, and it is unclear which plan tier includes 'LLM optimizations'.
